clips.title: The story
paras: Tools of the Trade is an initiation mission for Horde rogues given by Mennet Carkad in the Undercity. Ordered by Lord Varimathras, agents must obtain lockpicking gear and infiltrate Ambermill to recover sensitive Kirin Tor reports detailing Dalaran's current state.

Following the interrogation of one of their prisoners, the Deathstalkers learned that vital intelligence concerning the ruins of Dalaran lies hidden in Ambermill. Silverpine Forest remains a precarious front line, and the human mages guarding the village guard their communications fiercely. Under the orders of Lord Varimathras, Deathstalker handler Mennet Carkad directs promising operatives to bypass Kirin Tor sentries and secure the Dalaran Status Report.

Unlike straightforward assassinations, this mission serves as a practical proving ground in infiltration and lockpicking. Operatives are outfitted with specialized thieves' tools from Estelle Gendry before marching into hostile Kirin Tor territory. Cracking the secured chest in Ambermill demonstrates that an operative has progressed beyond raw street brutality into an indispensable espionage asset for the Forsaken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The wizards of the Kirin Tor at Ambermill have stored away important documents pertaining to the current state of Dalaran. This we know from the admissions of one of our prisoners. Lord Varimathras has placed the duty of recovering them in the hands of the Deathstalkers.
This task falls to you, friend. You will need some equipment, however, and the knowledge of lockpicking. Speak with Estelle Gendry, our outfitter, and ask her for a set of tools before you set out.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you located the documents, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good, friend! You have learned the fine art of lockpicking well, and faster than I could have possibly expected.
I see that I was right to place my trust in you. Believe me, kid, I foresee that you will go far in this line of work.
